summary: This clinical study looks at a new drug called enicepatide (also known as RO7795068) for adults who have obesity or are overweight without Type 2 diabetes. The study will compare the effects of different doses of enicepatide against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks just like the real drug. Researchers are planning to enroll 2000 participants to take part in this trial. The trial is currently recruiting participants to measure changes in body weight over time.
